meta.description: FF Master Robot RAG evaluation test cases

test_cases.question: What is the minimum safety distance that should be maintained around the FF Master robot during operation?
test_cases.expected_answer: A safety distance of at least 50 cm should be maintained according to safety guidelines, and a safety radius of at least 1 meter should be maintained around the robot according to safety precautions.

test_cases.question: What happens when the emergency stop is activated on the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: When the emergency stop is activated, all joints lose torque (zero-torque state), and the robot may collapse or fall. A protective cage should be used to prevent damage.

test_cases.question: What is the operating temperature range for the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The operating temperature range is -10°C to 40°C.

test_cases.question: What is the minimum static friction coefficient required for the operating surface?
test_cases.expected_answer: The operating surface must have a static friction coefficient greater than 0.4. The surface should be hard, flat, and non-slip.

test_cases.question: Under what conditions is manual intervention on the robot allowed?
test_cases.expected_answer: Manual intervention is only allowed when the robot is fully stopped and powered off. Manual intervention while the robot is moving or powered on is prohibited.

test_cases.question: What should you do if the robot experiences a short circuit or overheating?
test_cases.expected_answer: Disconnect the power immediately if there is a short circuit or overheating.

test_cases.question: What precautions should be taken for remote operation of the robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: A secure network should be used for remote operation, and operators need to maintain real-time monitoring of the robot.

test_cases.question: How many degrees of freedom (DOF) does the FF Master Ultra have?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra has 31 degrees of freedom (DOF). This includes 2 head DOF, 7 per arm (14 total), 6 per leg (12 total), and 3 waist DOF.

test_cases.question: What is the weight difference between FF Master and FF Master Ultra?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master and FF Master Edu weigh approximately 35 kg, while the FF Master Ultra weighs approximately 37 kg.

test_cases.question: What is the height of the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master robot is 1310 mm (approximately 1.31 meters) tall. Its dimensions are 1310(H) × 460(W) × 210(L) mm.

test_cases.question: What is the maximum walking speed of the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The maximum walking speed is 1.5 m/s, but the recommended walking speed is no more than 0.8 m/s.

test_cases.question: What is the payload capacity of the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The maximum payload is 3 kg in a specific pose, and no more than 1 kg across the full workspace.

test_cases.question: What is the battery capacity and walking endurance of the FF Master?
test_cases.expected_answer: The battery capacity is approximately 500 Wh. At a walking speed of 0.5 m/s, the endurance is approximately 2 hours.

test_cases.question: What is the arm reach of the FF Master Ultra compared to the FF Master?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra has an arm reach of 558 mm, while the FF Master and FF Master Edu have an arm reach of 437 mm.

test_cases.question: What is the peak joint torque of the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The peak joint torque is 120 N·m.

test_cases.question: What is the maximum obstacle height the robot can step over, and the maximum slope it can climb?
test_cases.expected_answer: The robot can step over obstacles up to 50 mm in height and climb slopes up to 15 degrees.

test_cases.question: What is the computational unit (PC2) used in the FF Master Ultra?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra uses a Jetson Orin NX as its PC2 (development computational unit). It has 157 TOPS of computing power, a 1024-core Ampere GPU with 32 Tensor Cores, 8-core Arm Cortex-A78AE, 16GB VRAM, 16GB RAM, and 512GB storage.

test_cases.question: How many computational units does the FF Master Ultra have, and what are their roles?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra has three computational units: PC1 for operations and control, PC2 (Jetson Orin NX) for development, and PC3 for interactive functions. The FF Master and FF Master Edu only have PC1 and PC3.

test_cases.question: What processor does the FF Master (non-Ultra) use?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master uses the RK3588 as the main processor (PC1) and RK3588s as the interactive processor (PC3).

test_cases.question: What are the DOF differences between FF Master, FF Master Edu, and FF Master Ultra?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master and FF Master Edu have 27 DOF each, with 5 DOF per arm. The FF Master Ultra has 31 DOF, with 7 DOF per arm (adding wrist pitch and wrist roll joints).

test_cases.question: Which FF Master models support secondary development?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master does not support secondary development. The FF Master Edu supports limited secondary development. The FF Master Ultra supports full secondary development.

test_cases.question: Which models are compatible with the Locomotion & Manipulation Platform?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Edu and FF Master Ultra are compatible with the Locomotion & Manipulation Platform. The FF Master is not compatible. The platform is currently under development.

test_cases.question: What sensors are equipped on the FF Master Ultra?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra is equipped with LiDAR, RGB-D camera, front stereo RGB cameras, front interactive RGB camera, and rear RGB camera.

test_cases.question: What sensors do the FF Master and FF Master Edu have?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master and FF Master Edu are equipped with an interactive RGB camera only.

test_cases.question: What is the range of motion for the head joints?
test_cases.expected_answer: The head has 2 DOF: pitch and yaw, each with a range of ±20 degrees.

test_cases.question: What additional arm joints does the FF Master Ultra have compared to the FF Master?
test_cases.expected_answer: The FF Master Ultra has two additional arm joints: J6 (Wrist pitch) with a range of ±32 degrees, and J7 (Wrist roll) with a range of ±88.5 degrees.

test_cases.question: What is the waist joint range of motion?
test_cases.expected_answer: The waist has 3 DOF: Yaw with a range of -196.5° to 136.5°, Pitch with a range of ±18°, and Roll with a range of ±28°.

test_cases.question: How do the battery indicator lights show when the battery level is below 15%?
test_cases.expected_answer: When the battery level is below 15%, only LED1 flashes (1 LED flashing). When between 15-25%, LED1 is steady (1 LED on). The robot may collapse suddenly when only one bar remains.

test_cases.question: How do the battery indicator lights display during charging?
test_cases.expected_answer: During charging: LED1 breathing means <25%, LED2 breathing means 25-50%, LED3 breathing means 50-75%, LED4 breathing means 75-100%. When all 4 LEDs are steady, the battery is fully charged at 100%.

test_cases.question: What does it mean when all 4 battery indicator LEDs are flashing simultaneously?
test_cases.expected_answer: When all 4 LEDs are flashing simultaneously, it indicates a battery protection mode has been triggered due to overtemperature, overcurrent, or overvoltage conditions.

test_cases.question: How do you power on the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: To power on: first short press the power button to wake it up, then long press for 5 seconds. The LEDs 1-4 will light up sequentially in about 2 seconds. The battery should be at least 50% (at least two bars) before startup.

test_cases.question: What is the button combination for starting the robot from a hoisted position?
test_cases.expected_answer: From a hoisted position: press [L2 + X] for standing preparation, then press [R2 + X] for stable standing.

test_cases.question: How do you start the robot from a supine (lying on back) position?
test_cases.expected_answer: Press [↑ + △] to execute the supine-to-stand procedure. A safety radius of at least 0.5 meters must be maintained. This method should not be used with end-effectors attached.

test_cases.question: What is required for starting the robot from a sitting position?
test_cases.expected_answer: The robot needs a platform 35-40 cm high. Press [↑ + X] for sitting preparation, then press [↑ + □] for sit-to-stand.

test_cases.question: How do you power off the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: To power off: short press the power button to wake the display, then long press for about 5 seconds. The LEDs will turn off sequentially.

test_cases.question: What is the button combination to enter Damping Mode?
test_cases.expected_answer: Press [L2 + R2 + Create] to enter Damping Mode.

test_cases.question: What is the button combination to enter Zero-Torque Mode?
test_cases.expected_answer: Press [L1 + R1 + Create] to enter Zero-Torque Mode.

test_cases.question: How do you shut down the robot from a standing position to sitting?
test_cases.expected_answer: Press [L2 + ←] to make the robot sit down, then enter Damping Mode [L2 + R2 + Create], then Zero-Torque Mode [L1 + R1 + Create], then power off.

test_cases.question: What are the two methods for charging the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: Method 1: Power off the robot and plug the charger directly into the robot's charging port. Method 2: Power off, remove the battery, and plug the charger into the battery's charging port. The charging port is magnetic and auto-aligns.

test_cases.question: Can you charge the FF Master robot while it is powered on?
test_cases.expected_answer: No, the robot must be powered off before charging. Do not charge while powered on.

test_cases.question: What is the charger specification for the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The charger accepts 100-220V input and outputs 54.6V at 10A. Full charging takes no more than 1.5 hours.

test_cases.question: What are the available control modes on the FF Master remote controller?
test_cases.expected_answer: The available modes are: Zero-Torque, Damping, Standing Prep, Sitting Prep, Stable Standing, Locomotion, Emergency-Stop, and Off-Road (Beta).

test_cases.question: What is the button combination for emergency stop on the remote controller?
test_cases.expected_answer: Press [L1 + R1 + Create] for emergency stop. To exit emergency stop, press [L2 + X].

test_cases.question: What are the limitations of Off-Road mode?
test_cases.expected_answer: In Off-Road mode (Beta), avoid stairs higher than 5 cm, slopes greater than 10 degrees, and elevation changes greater than ±5 cm.

test_cases.question: What is the control priority order when multiple control methods are used simultaneously?
test_cases.expected_answer: The control priority order is: Remote Controller > App > Voice. The remote controller has the highest priority.

test_cases.question: How long does the remote controller battery last, and how long does it take to charge?
test_cases.expected_answer: The remote controller battery lasts approximately 5 hours of use and takes approximately 3-4 hours to charge. Use a 5V 1A or 2A charger; avoid fast charging.

test_cases.question: What is the wake word for voice interaction with the FF Master robot?
test_cases.expected_answer: The upcoming built-in wake word is 'Hey, Master' (in English). Currently, only external microphone is supported and there is no wake word — the feature is under development.

test_cases.question: What languages are supported for voice interaction?
test_cases.expected_answer: The supported languages for voice interaction are: English, Chinese, Spanish, French, and Italian.

test_cases.question: What happens when you touch the robot's head?
test_cases.expected_answer: When you touch the robot's head, it nods and responds with 'Friendly touch signal detected — energy +100%!'

test_cases.question: What are the character customization limits for voice interaction?
test_cases.expected_answer: The character description is limited to 300 characters or less. For custom Q&A pairs, questions are limited to 20 characters and answers to 50 characters.
